verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents its own ways to reach HTTP services inside a sandbox. Private previews open a loopback-bound HTTP server for authenticated clients, a Services feature offers route-level controls (auth, CORS, rate limits, path rewrite), and inbound access can auto-resume a paused sandbox. However, the evidence never explicitly describes mapping an arbitrary port to a public preview URL; the documented preview mode is private and authenticated, and Functions expose handlers rather than ports. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of exposing a sandbox port on a public URL, details of the URL format and port mapping, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose a port from the sandbox on a public preview URL to reach services running inside

citations.quote: Private previews let an authenticated client open an HTTP server that listens only on sandbox loopback addresses.
route-level method filtering, auth, CORS, rate limits, timeout, and path rewrite
With auto_resume enabled, supported inbound access can wake a paused sandbox
